nodes.title: No-data citation field omitted hotfix
nodes.summary: The single corrective task that omits field entirely on a no-data citation, now that domain/investigation/citation and rules/investigation/a-cited-field-exists-in-the-capability-output-schema decide field is absent for that case, instead of filling it with an empty string sentinel.

nodes.title: A no-data citation omits field, never an empty-string sentinel
nodes.summary: Fixes judgment-stage.ts's noDataEvaluation and anthropic-hypothesis-evaluator.adapter.ts's noDataOutcome to construct a no-data citation with concept alone, omitting field entirely, instead of filling field with an empty string.
